description:
Save information to the user's MemoryPlugin account. MemoryPlugin lets users build persistent memory across AI conversations.

WHEN TO USE: When the user asks to remember something, or confirms that a specific fact, preference, decision, or project detail from the conversation should be kept for later. Save only that item. Ask the user which bucket to save to if unclear.

Buckets are organizational folders (e.g., 'Work', 'Personal', 'Health').

bucketId.description: Optional bucket ID to store the memory in

name: store_memory
title: Store memory
